title: Browse script text archives
changes: Display physical script-text programs by language and bank, drawing referenced font glyphs and labeling the original command and operand bytes.
Use a compact private projection of extracted data; show an explicit marker when a referenced glyph is unavailable.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-script-text-gcw9ab5e passed generator tests and Linux Chrome selector, glyph pixel, command and missing-glyph checks.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-script-text-eur-0liwj5t4 checked five languages, all 385 bank counts, 1155 sampled programs and all 147 referenced glyphs; Linux Chrome selected the final program.
limitations: Physical bank and program indices are not decoded gameplay message identifiers; dynamic substitutions and command semantics are not executed. Physical browser interaction on Windows was not checked.
Synthetic attempt rdna40zn failed because the test split JSON at a semicolon in a resource description; the test parser was corrected.
